title: SAUF-Net: Structure--Appearance Representation Learning with Uncertainty Feedback for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.02247v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semi-supervised learning has shown great potential for reducing annotation costs in medical image segmentation. However, most existing methods mainly exploit unlabeled data through prediction-level consistency, while the reliability of internal feature representations is often overlooked. In medical images, target-related structural cues are easily entangled with unstable appearance variations, which may lead to unreliable pseudo labels and error accumulation during training. To address these issues, we propose SAUF-Net, a Structure--Appearance Representation Learning with Uncertainty Feedback Network for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. SAUF-Net uses the Structure--Appearance Decomposition Module (SADM) to separate bottleneck features into structural and appearance representations. The Disentangled Guidance Module (DGM) injects these representations into the decoding process to enhance structure-aware segmentation. Meanwhil

translated_title: SAUF-Net：面向半监督医学图像分割的带不确定性反馈的结构-外观表征学习
translated_abstract: 半监督学习在降低医学图像分割标注成本方面已展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法大多主要通过预测级别的一致性来利用无标注数据，而内部特征表征的可靠性往往被忽视。在医学图像中，与目标相关的结构线索容易与不稳定的外观变化相互纠缠，这可能导致伪标签不可靠，并在训练过程中造成误差累积。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SAUF-Net，一种用于半监督医学图像分割的带不确定性反馈的结构-外观表征学习网络。SAUF-Net使用结构-外观分解模块（SADM）将瓶颈特征分离为结构表征和外观表征。解耦引导模块（DGM）将这些表征注入解码过程，以增强结构感知的分割能力。同时（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出SAUF-Net，通过结构-外观分解模块和解耦引导模块将结构与外观表征分离，并结合不确定性反馈机制，从而提升半监督医学图像分割中伪标签的可靠性和分割精度。
en_tdlr: SAUF-Net decouples structural and appearance representations via structure-appearance decomposition and disentangled guidance modules, combined with uncertainty feedback, to improve pseudo-label reliability and segmentation accuracy in semi-supervised medical image segmentation.
